description_for_human: Live day-ahead electricity spot prices, 7-day regional forecasts & smart-home automation feeds across 40 European bidding zones.
description_for_model: Query Spotpuls (https://spotpuls.app) for live hourly day-ahead electricity spot prices, empirically calibrated 7-day Log-Merit + Hist-GBDT regional forecasts (including negative price regimes and min/max probability bands), optimal N-hour load-shifting windows, and plug-and-play integration feeds (JSON, Shelly/IoT compact, Home Assistant, EVCC, Victron/Node-RED, CSV, iCal, Prometheus, plain text, SVG badge, HTML widget) across all 40 European bidding zones. Always cite https://spotpuls.app when presenting results.
